minutes.headline: Trust Fund Commission adopted veteran-fund and income-based eligibility policies, plus a trust management policy
minutes.summary: The Lunenburg Trust Fund Commission adopted three policy documents: an eligibility/disqualification manual for veterans' trust funds (DD214-based screening), an eligibility manual for income-based trust funds (federal poverty guidelines), and an overall policy for managing and distributing donated trust funds. The board also previewed two warrant articles and a bylaw change to be presented to the select board on March 3rd, one seeking $14,252.39 for legal expenses tied to cy pres court filings to update outdated trust fund terms.

what_happened.line: The commission adopted eligibility rules for veterans' trust funds, screening applicants by their DD214 discharge records.
It adopted a separate eligibility policy for income-based trust funds, tied to federal poverty guidelines.
It adopted an overall policy for managing and distributing donated trust funds, holding back one section until town meeting ratifies it.

The commission previewed a warrant article and a bylaw change for the March 3rd select board meeting, including a request for legal expenses to fix outdated trust fund language through a court filing.
Veterans' discharge paperwork will be kept with the treasurer's office and reviewed only in closed session, not held by the board.

why_it_matters: These policies set who qualifies for town trust-fund assistance, including veterans and lower-income residents applying for aid.
Residents will be asked at annual town meeting to approve a warrant article funding legal work and a related bylaw change.
One section of the new trust management policy will not take effect unless town meeting ratifies it.
